changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[GetRelationshipDisplayValue] ( @o varchar(50), @oid int ) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( select DisplayValue from dbo.Asset A cross apply [dbo].[GetAssetDisplayValueById](A.ID) DV where @o = 'FusionAttribute' and A.[Object] = @o and A.ObjectID = @oid union select DV.DisplayValue from dbo.Asset A inner join dbo.AssetDisplayValue DV on DV.AssetID = A.ID where @o not in('Taxonomy','FusionAttribute') and A.[Object] = @o and A.ObjectID = @oid union all select TextPath from dbo.Asset A cross apply [dbo].GetAssetTextPathById(A.ID,'/') where @o = 'Taxonomy' and A.[Object] = @o and A.ObjectID = @oid )
changeSet.rollback: CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[GetRelationshipDisplayValue] ( @o varchar(50), @oid int ) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( select DisplayValue from dbo.Asset A cross apply [dbo].[GetAssetDisplayValueById](A.ID) DV where @o != 'Taxonomy' and A.[Object] = @o and A.ObjectID = @oid union all select TextPath from dbo.Asset A cross apply [dbo].GetAssetTextPathById(A.ID,'/') where @o = 'Taxonomy' and A.[Object] = @o and A.ObjectID = @oid )

changeSet.author: kmcnamee
changeSet.sql:
CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[GetAssetTextPathById] ( @Id bigint, @delimiter nvarchar(5) ) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN (
with c as ( select T.ID as AssetID, P.ID as ParentID, T.Object as AssetObject, T.ObjectID as AssetObjectID, T.ID, T.Object, T.ObjectID, D.DisplayValue, 1 as Level from Asset T outer apply dbo.GetAssetDisplayValueById(T.ID) D outer apply dbo.GetParentByAssetID(T.ID) P where T.ID = @Id union all select c.AssetID, P.ID as ParentID, c.AssetObject, c.AssetObjectID, T.ID, T.Object, T.ObjectID, D.DisplayValue + @delimiter + c.DisplayValue as DisplayValue, c.Level + 1 as Level from Asset T outer apply dbo.GetAssetDisplayValueById(T.ID) D outer apply dbo.GetParentByAssetID(T.ID) P inner join c on c.ParentID = T.ID ), c2 as ( select T.ID as AssetID, P.ID as ParentID, T.Object as AssetObject, T.ObjectID as AssetObjectID, T.ID, T.Object, T.ObjectID, D.DisplayValue, 1 as Level from Asset T outer apply dbo.GetAssetDisplayValueById(T.ID) D outer apply dbo.GetParentByAssetID(T.ID) P where T.ID = @Id union all select c2.AssetID, P.ID as ParentID, c2.AssetObject, c2.AssetObjectID, T.ID, T.Object, T.ObjectID, D.DisplayValue + @delimiter + c2.DisplayValue as DisplayValue, c2.Level + 1 as Level from Asset T outer apply dbo.GetAssetDisplayValueById(T.ID) D outer apply dbo.GetParentByAssetID(T.ID) P inner join c2 on c2.ParentID = T.ID )
(select top 1 AssetID as ID, AssetObject as Object, AssetObjectID as ObjectID, DisplayValue as TextPath, Level from c where c.AssetObject = 'FusionAttribute' order by Level desc) union all (select top 1 AssetID as ID, AssetObject as Object, AssetObjectID as ObjectID, DisplayValue as TextPath, Level from c2 where c2.AssetObject != 'FusionAttribute' order by Level desc) )
changeSet.rollback:
CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[GetAssetTextPathById] ( @Id bigint, @delimiter nvarchar(5) ) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN (
with c as ( select T.ID as AssetID, P.ID as ParentID, T.Object as AssetObject, T.ObjectID as AssetObjectID, T.ID, T.Object, T.ObjectID, D.DisplayValue, 1 as Level from Asset T outer apply dbo.GetAssetDisplayValueById(T.ID) D outer apply dbo.GetParentByAssetID(T.ID) P where T.ID = @Id union all select c.AssetID, P.ID as ParentID, c.AssetObject, c.AssetObjectID, T.ID, T.Object, T.ObjectID, D.DisplayValue + @delimiter + c.DisplayValue as DisplayValue, c.Level + 1 as Level from Asset T outer apply dbo.GetAssetDisplayValueById(T.ID) D outer apply dbo.GetParentByAssetID(T.ID) P inner join c on c.ParentID = T.ID )
select top 1 AssetID as ID, AssetObject as Object, AssetObjectID as ObjectID, DisplayValue as TextPath, Level from c order by Level desc )
